digest.component_or_area: Automated bug filing infrastructure (canary bridge filers and reconciler conflict filer)
propositions: Three existing automated bug filers (heartbeat alert, binding-drift alert, conflict filer) lack deduplication, allowing duplicate tickets and spam from flaky runs or state changes.
Heartbeat filer must implement a 2-consecutive-red threshold by querying workflow run history to avoid filing on single flakes.
All three filers must use stable dedup tags, templated bodies with abort-if-empty-detail, and accumulation-comment dedup (max one per 24h) to prevent duplicate tickets.
Binding-drift filer requires no consecutive-red threshold because drift is persistent state that cannot self-heal; its dedup and daily accumulation alone suffice.
Conflict filer must extract per-conflict stable dedup tags (derived from local id + Jira key), template fields, and abort-if-empty logic, without retrofitting auto-close (adjudication required).
Bug-creation contract must document exact rebar create args, dedup search commands, exit codes, and REBAR_DETECTED_BY env var so all future filers produce well-formed tickets.
